6 May 2024
The claim was opened after the insured reported a rear-end collision at low speed, and the claimant's representing
attorney has asked that all contact go through their office.
18 May 2024
Photos taken at the scene show damage to the rear of the claimant's vehicle, and the damage is mostly in line with
the impact described by the parties.
22 Jul 2024
The police report and two parties at the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time, though no
independent witnesses were located.
31 Aug 2024
The driver is named on the policy and the policy was in force on the date of loss, with nothing suggesting the damage
predates coverage.
6 Sep 2024
No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records, and the repair estmiate was
reviewed against the photos.
7 Sep 2024
The claimant's neck strain was reported to the attorney's office, and the reported injury matches the kind and force of
a crash of this type.
12 Oct 2024
Treatment followed a usual course, with physical therapy tapering as the patient improved, and no earlier injury to the
same body area is known from prior records.
18 Nov 2024
The claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far, and the file is being prepared for a settlement
review with the attorney's office.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
